At some point, I think I need to let the phone charge to 90%, I need to stop charging in time, because the phone has been charging, the damage to the battery is impenetrable, a small amount of battery charging and charging to 80%-90% is the best, so our APP was born, what can it do for you:
1, set the charging target value, when the mobile phone charging reaches the target value, we will prompt you in time, you can unplug the mobile phone charging cable at any time to prevent excessive charging.
2, when charging, we simulate a real charging value, and you can intuitively see the change of power when charging.
3. How much do you know about battery maintenance? Is your phone charged correctly? We'll give you the answers in the APP.
4, we support quick command one-click wake up, when the phone plugged in the charger, we will automatically wake up and give you a charging reminder function.

Use tips: When charging, set the target value, open the APP and place it.

About privacy: Completely offline APP, no information collected.
Of course, if you have good ideas and suggestions, you can leave a message through the APP comments, I will always pay attention to your ideas and suggestions.
